description: This file defines the API and data structures for network context management in Zephyr OS, including callback types, context flags, and functions for creating, managing, and configuring network connections.

methods.name: net_context_is_used
methods.description: Checks if the network context is currently in use based on its flags.

methods.name: net_context_is_bound_to_iface
methods.description: Checks if the network context is bound to a specific network interface.

methods.name: net_context_is_accepting
methods.description: Checks if the network context is accepting incoming connections.

methods.name: net_context_set_accepting
methods.description: Sets the accepting state of the network context.

methods.name: net_context_is_closing
methods.description: Checks if the network context is in closing state.

methods.name: net_context_set_closing
methods.description: Sets the closing state of the network context.

methods.name: net_context_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the network context.

methods.name: net_context_set_state
methods.description: Sets the state of the network context.

methods.name: net_context_get_family
methods.description: Returns the address family (IPv4, IPv6, etc.) of the context.

methods.name: net_context_set_family
methods.description: Sets the address family for the network context.

methods.name: net_context_get_type
methods.description: Returns the socket type (stream, datagram, raw) of the context.

methods.name: net_context_set_type
methods.description: Sets the socket type for the network context.

methods.name: net_context_set_can_filter_id
methods.description: Sets the CAN filter ID for the context (if applicable).

methods.name: net_context_get_can_filter_id
methods.description: Gets the CAN filter ID of the context (if applicable).

methods.name: net_context_get_proto
methods.description: Returns the IP protocol (UDP, TCP, etc.) of the context.

methods.name: net_context_set_proto
methods.description: Sets the IP protocol for the context.

methods.name: net_context_get_iface
methods.description: Returns the network interface associated with the context.

methods.name: net_context_set_iface
methods.description: Binds a network interface to the context.

methods.name: net_context_bind
methods.description: Assigns a local address to the context, similar to BSD bind().

methods.name: net_context_listen
methods.description: Marks the context as a listening socket.

methods.name: net_context_connect
methods.description: Creates a connection to a remote address, similar to BSD connect().

methods.name: net_context_accept
methods.description: Accepts incoming connection attempts, similar to BSD accept().

methods.name: net_context_send
methods.description: Sends data to a connected peer.

methods.name: net_context_sendto
methods.description: Sends data to a specific address, used for datagram sockets.

methods.name: net_context_sendmsg
methods.description: Sends data using msghdr, similar to POSIX sendmsg().

methods.name: net_context_recv
methods.description: Registers a callback to receive incoming data.

methods.name: net_context_update_recv_wnd
methods.description: Updates the TCP receive window size.

methods.name: net_context_set_option
methods.description: Sets a socket option for the context.

methods.name: net_context_get_option
methods.description: Retrieves a socket option value.

methods.name: net_context_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all network contexts, calling a callback for each.
